{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
raw_data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float

# Check for the six QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_orders = raw_data[raw_data['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Remove QA orders from the dataset
clean_data = raw_data[raw_data['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = clean_data[clean_data['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Remove refunded orders for revenue analysis (though not needed here)
final_data = clean_data[clean_data['status'] == 'completed']

# Now compute mean age, excluding -1 values
valid_ages = final_data[final_data['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()
